title: n8n Business Automation - Part 2
description: Business automation with n8n covering workflow design, nodes, triggers, webhooks, HTTP requests, expressions, database workflows, and AI automation. This submodule covers: HTTP requests, JSON, Expressions, Conditions, Loops, Database workflows.
learning_outcomes: Design and build automation workflows in n8n
Use various nodes for data processing and transformation
Create triggers from webhooks, schedules, and events
